title: Severianus on 2 Thessalonians
english: Again, regarding the persecutions in which the Thessalonians remained, he comforts them. From his own prologue, he remembers the just and great retribution of Christ, who defends the wicked and crowns the saints.

Furthermore, because there was much inquiry concerning the second coming of Christ and when he will come, he corrects the opinions regarding this, so that they are not overtaken or led astray by foreign teachings. He also posits the manner and the sequence of the coming of Christ, which is to be again after the deception of the antichrist.

The love with righteousness is not only to love, but also to love in return. That which is said, if it is just, is not of doubt, but of exhortation and confession; for it is said in ethics, as we often say, of a day being: 'if it is a day.' He is giving vengeance to those who do not know God, instead of bringing punishment to the ungodly, with angels of his power in fiery flame. The terror of the glorious presence is presented also through these, and through which he brings punishment to the unrighteous, encouraging [the faithful]; for a great comfort is not only the reward for the sufferings, but also the punishment occurring against those who have done them wrong.

That our testimony was believed on that day; for the faith here prepares the reward on that day. What kind? In which Christ shall come. He exhorts them not to be disturbed unseasonably before the appearance of the Lord, whether if prophets should say to be, in whom the spirit of error is, or if words and rumors concerning the Lord should be scattered, or if having forged some letter they should bring it as ours. For unless the apostasy comes first and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction, the opponent and being lifted up above all, called god or object of reverence. Do not expect, he says, the savior before the plan which must come first, as I was saying.
